sentences.text: Menurut kabar desa, beberapa ekor kambing terbunuh oleh anjing liar minggu lalu.
sentences.en: According to village news, several goats were killed by wild dogs last week.
sentences.ko: 마을 소식에 따르면 지난주에 들개들 때문에 염소 몇 마리가 죽었대요.

sentences.text: Dalam novel yang dibaca Putri, seorang saksi terbunuh di bab pertama.
sentences.en: In the novel Putri is reading, a witness is killed in the first chapter.
sentences.ko: 푸트리가 읽는 소설에서는 첫 장에서 증인 한 명이 살해당해요.

sentences.text: Sejak kakeknya tiada, Dimas yang mengurus kebun kopi keluarga.
sentences.en: Since his grandfather passed away, Dimas has been the one looking after the family coffee garden.
sentences.ko: 할아버지가 돌아가신 뒤로 디마스가 집안 커피 농장을 돌보고 있어요.

sentences.text: Bagi Putri, tiada hari tanpa secangkir kopi.
sentences.en: For Putri, there's no day without a cup of coffee.
sentences.ko: 푸트리에게 커피 한 잔 없는 날은 없어요.
